passages.text: Later, by the Sea of Tiberias, Jesus again revealed Himself to the disciples. He made Himself known in this way: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.
passages.sermon: Jesus is the Christ. He is the Son of God. He revealed Himself again to His disciples. This happened by the Sea of Tiberias. Simon Peter was there. Thomas, who is called Didymus, was there. Nathanael from Cana in Galilee was there. The sons of Zebedee were there. Two other disciples were also there. All these disciples were together.
passages.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἐφανέρωσεν ἑαυτὸν πάλιν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς Τιβεριάδος ἐφανέρωσεν δὲ οὕτως ἦσαν ὁμοῦ Σίμων Πέτρος καὶ Θωμᾶς ὁ λεγόμενος Δίδυμος καὶ Ναθαναὴλ ὁ ἀπὸ Κανᾶ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ οἱ τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ ἄλλοι ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ δύο

passages.text: Simon Peter told them, “I am going fishing.” “We will go with you,” they said. So they went out and got into the boat, but caught nothing that night.
passages.sermon:
Simon Peter was a disciple of Jesus.
Simon Peter spoke to the other disciples.
Simon Peter said, “I am going fishing.”
The other disciples answered him.
They said, “We will go with you.”
Simon Peter and the other disciples left together.
They got into the boat.
They fished during the night.
They caught nothing that night.
passages.original: λέγει αὐτοῖς Σίμων Πέτρος Ὑπάγω ἁλιεύειν Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Ἐρχόμεθα καὶ ἡμεῖς σὺν σοί ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἐνέβησαν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ νυκτὶ ἐπίασαν οὐδέν

passages.text: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not recognize that it was Jesus.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son of God.
He rose from the dead.
He appeared to His disciples after His resurrection.
Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore.
The disciples saw Him.
The disciples did not know it was Jesus.
passages.original: Πρωΐας δὲ ἤδη γενομένης ἔστη Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸν αἰγιαλόν οὐ μέντοι ᾔδεισαν οἱ μαθηταὶ ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν

passages.text: So He called out to them, “Children, do you have any fish?” “No,” they answered.
passages.sermon:
Jesus stood on the shore.
He spoke to His disciples.
He called out to them.
He said, “Children, do you have any fish?”
The disciples answered Him.
They said, “No.”
passages.original: λέγει οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Παιδία μή τι προσφάγιον ἔχετε Ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ Οὔ

passages.text: He told them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” So they cast it there, and they were unable to haul it in because of the great number of fish.
passages.sermon:
Jesus stood on the shore early in the morning.
The disciples did not recognize Jesus.
Jesus spoke to the disciples.
Jesus said, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat.
You will find fish.”
The disciples cast the net on the right side.
They caught many fish.
They could not haul the net in because there were so many fish.
passages.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Βάλετε εἰς τὰ δεξιὰ μέρη τοῦ πλοίου τὸ δίκτυον καὶ εὑρήσετε ἔβαλον οὖν καὶ οὐκέτι αὐτὸ ἑλκύσαι ἴσχυον ἀπὸ τοῦ πλήθους τῶν ἰχθύων

passages.text: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord!” As soon as Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment (for he had removed it) and jumped into the sea.
passages.sermon:
Jesus had a disciple whom he loved.
This disciple spoke to Peter.
He said to Peter, “It is the Lord!”
Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord.
Simon Peter had taken off his outer garment.
He put on his outer garment.
Simon Peter jumped into the sea.
passages.original: Λέγει οὖν ὁ μαθητὴς ἐκεῖνος ὃν ἠγάπα ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ Πέτρῳ Ὁ Κύριός ἐστιν Σίμων οὖν Πέτρος ἀκούσας ὅτι ὁ Κύριός ἐστιν τὸν ἐπενδύτην διεζώσατο ἦν γὰρ γυμνός καὶ ἔβαλεν ἑαυτὸν εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν

passages.text: The other disciples came ashore in the boat. They dragged in the net full of fish, for they were not far from land, only about a hundred yards.
passages.sermon:
The other disciples followed in the boat.
They came toward the shore.
They were not far from land.
They were about a hundred yards away.
They dragged the net full of fish behind them.
passages.original: οἱ δὲ ἄλλοι μαθηταὶ τῷ πλοιαρίῳ ἦλθον οὐ γὰρ ἦσαν μακρὰν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἀλλὰ ὡς ἀπὸ πηχῶν διακοσίων σύροντες τὸ δίκτυον τῶν ἰχθύων

passages.text: When they landed, they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it, and some bread.
passages.sermon:
The disciples landed on the shore.
They saw a charcoal fire there.
They saw fish on the fire.
They saw some bread.
passages.original: Ὡς οὖν ἀπέβησαν εἰς τὴν γῆν βλέπουσιν ἀνθρακιὰν κειμένην καὶ ὀψάριον ἐπικείμενον καὶ ἄρτον

passages.text: Jesus told them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”
passages.sermon: Jesus spoke to the disciples.\r\nHe said, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”
passages.original: Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐνέγκατε ἀπὸ τῶν ὀψαρίων ὧν ἐπιάσατε νῦν

passages.text: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many, the net was not torn.
passages.sermon:
Simon Peter was one of Jesus’ disciples.
Simon Peter went to the boat.
He pulled the net to the shore.
The net was full of large fish.
There were 153 fish in the net.
The net did not tear, even though there were so many fish.
passages.original: ἀνέβη οὖν Σίμων Πέτρος καὶ εἵλκυσεν τὸ δίκτυον εἰς τὴν γῆν μεστὸν ἰχθύων μεγάλων ἑκατὸν πεντήκοντα τριῶν καὶ τοσούτων ὄντων οὐκ ἐσχίσθη τὸ δίκτυον

passages.text: “Come, have breakfast,” Jesus said to them. None of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?” They knew it was the Lord.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus had risen from the dead.
Jesus said, “Come and have breakfast.”
None of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?”
The disciples knew He was the Lord.
passages.original: Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Δεῦτε ἀριστήσατε οὐδεὶς δὲ ἐτόλμα τῶν μαθητῶν ἐξετάσαι αὐτόν Σὺ τίς εἶ εἰδότες ὅτι ὁ Κύριός ἐστιν

passages.text: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and He did the same with the fish.
passages.sermon:
Jesus came to the disciples.
He took the bread.
He gave the bread to them.
He took the fish.
He gave the fish to them.
passages.original: ἔρχεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ λαμβάνει τὸν ἄρτον καὶ δίδωσιν αὐτοῖς καὶ τὸ ὀψάριον ὁμοίως

passages.text: This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead.
passages.sermon: Jesus had been raised from the dead.\r\nHe appeared to His disciples.\r\nThis was the third time Jesus appeared to them after His resurrection.
passages.original: Τοῦτο ἤδη τρίτον ἐφανερώθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἐγερθεὶς ἐκ νεκρῶν

passages.text: When they had finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus replied, “Feed My lambs.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus had risen from the dead.
He appeared to His disciples for the third time.
They finished eating together.
Jesus spoke to Simon Peter.
Jesus said, “Simon, son of John, do you love Me more than these?”
Simon Peter answered, “Yes, Lord. You know I love You.”
Jesus said to him, “Feed My lambs.”
passages.original: Ὅτε οὖν ἠρίστησαν λέγει τῷ Σίμωνι Πέτρῳ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Σίμων Ἰωάννου ἀγαπᾷς με πλέον τούτων Λέγει αὐτῷ Ναί Κύριε σὺ οἶδας ὅτι φιλῶ σε Λέγει αὐτῷ Βόσκε τὰ ἀρνία μου

passages.text: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus told him, “Shepherd My sheep.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus had risen from the dead.
He appeared to His disciples.
Jesus spoke to Simon Peter.
Jesus asked Simon Peter a second time.
He said, “Simon, son of John, do you love Me?”
Simon Peter answered Jesus.
He said, “Yes, Lord. You know I love You.”
Jesus told Simon Peter, “Shepherd My sheep.”
passages.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ πάλιν δεύτερον Σίμων Ἰωάννου ἀγαπᾷς με Λέγει αὐτῷ Ναί Κύριε σὺ οἶδας ὅτι φιλῶ σε Λέγει αὐτῷ Ποίμαινε τὰ πρόβατά μου

passages.text: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?” “Lord, You know all things,” he replied. “You know I love You.” Jesus said to him, “Feed My sheep.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to Simon Peter.
Jesus is the Son of God.
Simon Peter is the son of John.
Jesus asked Simon Peter a third time.
He said, “Simon, son of John, do you love Me?”
Peter felt very sad.
Peter was hurt because Jesus asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?”
Peter answered Jesus.
Peter said, “Lord, You know everything.”
Peter said, “You know that I love You.”
Jesus said to Peter, “Feed My sheep.”
passages.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ τὸ τρίτον Σίμων Ἰωάννου φιλεῖς με Ἐλυπήθη ὁ Πέτρος ὅτι εἶπεν αὐτῷ τὸ τρίτον Φιλεῖς με Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Κύριε πάντα σὺ οἶδας σὺ γινώσκεις ὅτι φιλῶ σε Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Βόσκε τὰ πρόβατά μου

passages.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted; but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to Peter.
Jesus said, “Truly, truly, I tell you.”
When you were young, you dressed yourself.
You walked wherever you wanted.
When you are old, you will stretch out your hands.
Someone else will dress you.
Someone else will lead you where you do not want to go.”
passages.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ὅτε ἦς νεώτερος ἐζώννυες σεαυτὸν καὶ περιεπάτεις ὅπου ἤθελες ὅταν δὲ γηράσῃς ἐκτενεῖς τὰς χεῖράς σου καὶ ἄλλος ζώσει σε καὶ οἴσει ὅπου οὐ θέλεις

passages.text: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. And after He had said this, He told him, “Follow Me.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to Peter.
Jesus explained something important to Peter.
Jesus showed what kind of death Peter would have.
Peter’s death would glorify God.
After Jesus said this, He spoke again to Peter.
Jesus told Peter, “Follow Me.”
passages.original: τοῦτο δὲ εἶπεν σημαίνων ποίῳ θανάτῳ δοξάσει τὸν Θεόν Καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν λέγει αὐτῷ Ἀκολούθει μοι

passages.text: Peter turned and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them. He was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper to ask, “Lord, who is going to betray You?”
passages.sermon:
Peter was a disciple of Jesus.
Peter turned around.
Peter saw another disciple following them.
Jesus loved this disciple.
This disciple had leaned back against Jesus at the supper.
At the supper, this disciple had asked Jesus a question.
He had asked, “Lord, who is going to betray You?”
passages.original: Ἐπιστραφεὶς ὁ Πέτρος βλέπει τὸν μαθητὴν ὃν ἠγάπα ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀκολουθοῦντα ὃς καὶ ἀνέπεσεν ἐν τῷ δείπνῳ ἐπὶ τὸ στῆθος αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν Κύριε τίς ἐστιν ὁ παραδιδούς σε

passages.text: When Peter saw him, he asked, “Lord, what about him?”
passages.sermon:
Peter was a disciple of Jesus.
Peter saw the disciple whom Jesus loved.
Peter spoke to Jesus.
Peter asked Jesus a question.
Peter said, “Lord, what about him?”
passages.original: τοῦτον οὖν ἰδὼν ὁ Πέτρος λέγει τῷ Ἰησοῦ Κύριε οὗτος δὲ τί

passages.text: Jesus answered, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you? You follow Me!”
passages.sermon: Jesus spoke to Peter.\r\nJesus said, “If I want that disciple to remain until I return, that does not concern you.\r\nYou must follow Me.”
passages.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐὰν αὐτὸν θέλω μένειν ἕως ἔρχομαι τί πρὸς σέ σύ μοι ἀκολούθει

passages.text: Because of this, the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple would not die. However, Jesus did not say that he would not die, but only, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you?”
passages.sermon:
A rumor spread among the believers.
The rumor said that this disciple would not die.
Jesus did not say that this disciple would not die.
Jesus only said, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you?”
passages.original: ἐξῆλθεν οὖν οὗτος ὁ λόγος εἰς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὅτι ὁ μαθητὴς ἐκεῖνος οὐκ ἀποθνήσκει οὐκ εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι οὐκ ἀποθνήσκει ἀλλ’ Ἐὰν αὐτὸν θέλω μένειν ἕως ἔρχομαι τί πρὸς σέ

passages.text: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who has written them down. And we know that his testimony is true.
passages.sermon: This disciple testifies about these things.\r\nThis disciple wrote these things down.\r\nWe know his testimony is true.
passages.original: Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ μαθητὴς ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ τούτων καὶ ὁ γράψας ταῦτα καὶ οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἀληθὴς αὐτοῦ ἡ μαρτυρία ἐστίν

passages.text: There are many more things that Jesus did. If all of them were written down, I suppose that not even the world itself would have space for the books that would be written.
passages.sermon:
Jesus did many other things.
These things are not all written down.
If someone wrote down every one of them,
I think the world itself could not hold all the books.
passages.original: Ἔστιν δὲ καὶ ἄλλα πολλὰ ἃ ἐποίησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἅτινα ἐὰν γράφηται καθ’ ἕν οὐδ’ αὐτὸν οἶμαι τὸν κόσμον χωρήσειν τὰ γραφόμενα βιβλία
